'''1999 Calamari Regionals''' was a Star Wars CCG regional held in Melbourne, Australia on 16 October 1999. [[Stuart Jones]] won it. It is known from Michael Josem's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d87">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/1999-10-26-melbourne-australia-16-oct-99d87/ melbourne-australia-16-oct-99], DeckTech (Michael "Joz" Josem, 26 October 1999). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/1999-10-26-melbourne-australia-16-oct-99d87/ GitHub Pages].</ref>

* '''Date:''' 16 October 1999
* '''Site:''' Melbourne, Australia
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Endor]]
* '''Winner:''' [[Stuart Jones]]
